mcq: Fill in the blank: ______ is a type of human-powered land vehicle powered by the arms rather than the legs, as on a bicycle.
A handcycle is a type of human-powered land vehicle powered by the arms rather than the legs, as on a bicycle.
Fill in the blank: ______ is one of the steps in planning facilities construction.
Review of the General Plan is one of the steps in planning facilities construction.
Fill in the blank: ______ are responsible for maintaining, ordering, and inventorying sports equipment and apparel.
Managers are responsible for maintaining, ordering, and inventorying sports equipment and apparel.
Fill in the blank: ______ refers to those disposable items used in sports.
Sports equipment refers to those disposable items used in sports.
Fill in the blank: ______ is considered when for physical education classes (a) assigning students (b) rotating students (c) scheduling students.
A teaching station concept is considered when for physical education classes (a) assigning students (b) rotating students (c) scheduling students 2.
fib: ______ is a group of sports facilities.
A sports complex is a group of sports facilities.
______ is a major consideration in most physical education, athletic and recreational programmes.
The physical plant is a major consideration in most physical education, athletic and recreational programmes.
______ is the space or setting where one teacher or staff member can carry on physical education activities for one group of students.
A teaching station is the space or setting where one teacher or staff member can carry on physical education activities for one group of students.
______ is a major driving force behind change in any industry, especially sport.
Technological innovation is a major driving force behind change in any industry, especially sport.
______ are those materials and structures that can conveniently be constructed or enclosed in the four-wall of a building called gymnasium to facilitate learning programme.
Indoor facilities are those materials and structures that can conveniently be constructed or enclosed in the four-wall of a building called gymnasium to facilitate learning programme.
